title: Nvidia closes in on Hugging Face acquisition
description: Nvidia has reportedly agreed to buy Hugging Face, the popular open-source AI hub, for $12.9 billion in a move that would let Nvidia both protect its chip empire and jump back into the cloud business.
author: Connie Loizos

title: Viral AI startup Instinct has raised $350M at a $2.5B valuation
description: The startup is only a year old but it has already generated a massive amount of hype (and money) while also spurring privacy concerns.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Amazon just tripled its order of Nvidia chips over ‘surging demand’
description: Amazon is adding another 2 million Nvidia GPU chips to its data centers over the next two years. But this extended partnerships stretches beyond buying more chips.
author: Rebecca Bellan, Kirsten Korosec

title: Anthropic continues compute-gobbling streak in $45B deal with Nscale
description: The new deal with the infrastructure provider is the latest example of Anthropic's white-hot compute-gobbling streak.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Google’s Gemini has a branding problem, and so does the rest of AI
description: Consumer AI apps need to stop making users learn their product architecture.
author: Sarah Perez

title: How do we explain OpenAI’s executive exodus?
description: Was Greg Brockman the right executive all along?
author: Tim Fernholz

title: OpenAI releases its official report on the Hugging Face breach
description: The report, which spans several discrete cybersecurity compromises, is the most complete accounting of the incident to date.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Radar makes podcasts searchable — and usable by AI agents
description: Particle’s new podcast intelligence platform transcribes and analyzes more than 130,000 podcasts, making their conversations searchable on the web and accessible to AI agents through an API and MCP.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Ex-Meta scientists want to bring visual AI to the factory floor
description: Perceptron offers an AI model that it says can help machines navigate the world while also providing in-depth visual intelligence.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Bill Gates wants to see a robot tax and ‘Human Reserved’ jobs to mitigate harms from AI
description: Gates is mostly in the Responsible AI camp, but there are a few ideas in here we hadn't heard before.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Surprise: Z.ai is the AI lab behind the mysterious Ox Alpha model
description: Z.ai confirms it is behind Ox Alpha, the mysterious open AI model topping benchmarks and leaderboards, and its weights are set to be released soon.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Robot brain builders are pushing out of their GPT-2 era
description: Robot bodies are waiting for their AI brains to catch up.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: QueryStory wants you to believe what AI is telling you
description: The startup came out of stealth with $6 million in seed funding and a plan to use LLMs and cybersecurity know-how to make AI queries coherent.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Arga Labs is building a better way to train enterprise AI agents
description: Arga has raised $10 million in a seed funding round that was led by General Catalyst, with participation from Box Group, Emergence, Gradient and SV Angel.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Hearing tech startup Legato emerges from stealth with $12M and a peek at its AI hearing glasses
description: The glasses, called Legato Frames, integrate the company’s patented hearing-assistance technology into the arms of eyewear frames.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Runable hits $21M to bet AI agents can go from building businesses to growing them
description: Runable says 60% to 70% of its 1 trillion-plus token usage in the last 90 days came from paying customers.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: India’s Ringg gets backing from Peak XV as it pushes voice AI past the phone call
description: Ringg has raised $10 million from Peak XV as a part of its Series A extension.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Robotics startup Generalist reaches $3B valuation, sources say
description: The $200 million extension comes just months after the physical AI startup reached a $2 billion valuation.
author: Marina Temkin

title: OpenAI loses a top data center exec as stream of high-profile departures continues
description: In a statement to TechCrunch about Malone's departure, OpenAI said it had "recently reorganized" its "infrastructure organization to support the scale and pace of our work."
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Stability AI, maker of image generator Stable Diffusion, raises $76 million in fresh funding
description: The company's new fundraising total now stands at $232 million.
author: Lucas Ropek
